name: dth-phc
title: Digital Transformation Handbook for Primary Health Care: optimizing person-centred point of service systems

directories.description: The working document of the DTH on primary health care and person-centred point of service systems (PCPOSS): its document, chapters and blocks, seeded from the L1 entry who-iris/library/9789240093362-eng and structured against smart-base and smart-ra.

The five executable BPMN 2.0 workflows (lifecycle, Ch. 3 requirements, Ch. 4 design & adaptation, Ch. 5 training/testing/roll-out, Ch. 6 scale-up), their rendered SVGs and checklists, and the five DMN 1.5 decision tables.

The handbook's glossary as a folio-glossary/v1 SKOS scheme: all terms defined in who-iris/library/9789240093362-eng/sections/sec-002-glossary.md and PHC abbreviations from sec-001-abbreviations.md, cross-linked to smart-ra (dpi-h-ra and full-stac) and smart-base DAK vocabulary.

The dth-phc ArchiMate overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) model, one folder per SemVer version, named by archimate/cat-archimate.config.json. A DTH builds an overlay and does not add to smart-ra (owner, 2026-11-01, Q-RA1 A; dth-phc#8): elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element, elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-phc are this DTH's own. scripts/archimate/extract_overlay.py built 0.1.0-draft.1 from the PHC work once in smart-ra#182.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
People's outstanding items and the feedback raised against blocks; its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.
The trashcan that is kept: deprecated and removed content, each node declaring itself `folio-fsh-guts/v1` with where it came from. Never rendered.

description: WHO Digital transformation handbook for primary health care: optimizing person-centred point of service systems (ISBN 978-92-4-009336-2), as an L2 DTH on smart-ra and smart-base: the working document folio seeded from its L1 entry in who-iris (9789240093362-eng), and its SKOS glossary linked to the smart-ra glossary (dpi-h-ra / full-stac) and smart-base DAK vocabulary.
